title: Dieselpunk
content: Apply dieselpunk aesthetic with interwar period retro-futurism. Art Deco combined with diesel machinery. Chrome, steel, and brass metals. 1920s-40s vehicle and aircraft aesthetics. Dark, industrial color palette with gold accents. Include propellers, rivets, analog gauges. Film noir lighting influence. Streamlined industrial design. Gritty, powerful, alternative history atmosphere.

variants.simple: Create 1920s-40s retro-futurism with art deco machines, diesel-powered tech, and noir atmosphere.
variants.detailed: Apply dieselpunk aesthetic with interwar period retro-futurism. Art Deco combined with diesel machinery. Chrome, steel, and brass metals. 1920s-40s vehicle and aircraft aesthetics. variants.advanced: Apply dieselpunk aesthetic with 1920s-1940s retro-futurism. Era fusion: Art Deco elegance meets industrial diesel machinery, interwar period technology imagined forward. Metal palette: chrome silver, brushed steel (#71797e), brass (#b5a642), gunmetal (#2a3439), copper accents. Art Deco elements: geometric patterns, sunburst motifs, stepped forms, but grittier than pure Deco. Machinery: diesel engines, propellers, massive industrial equipment, visible gears and pistons, riveted panels. Vehicles: streamlined trains, zeppelins, propeller aircraft, massive ships, tank-like automobiles. Analog tech: gauges, dials, vacuum tubes, mechanical switches, ticker tape. Typography: bold Art Deco fonts (Broadway, Futura Display), industrial stencil, newspaper headlines. Color palette: dark and industrial - charcoal, navy, burgundy, olive - with brass/gold accents, occasional warning red. Lighting: film noir influenced - dramatic shadows, single light sources, smoky atmosphere. Texture: riveted metal panels, leather, oiled machinery, concrete. Military influence: uniforms, insignia, propaganda poster style. Characters: aviators, engineers, femme fatales in period dress. Sound suggested: engine rumble, mechanical clicks. Noir narrative: mystery, intrigue, alternative history. Interactive: mechanical movements, gauge animations, industrial sounds. Implementation: metal textures via gradients, SVG for machinery details. Accessibility: dark interface needs careful contrast, ensure readability despite atmospheric lighting.
